title: implement opt_fn_with_sgd

atoms.evidence: optimizer = optim.SGD((xy,), lr=lr, momentum=momentum) — pass (xy,) instead of model.parameters() so SGD steps over a single (x,y) coordinate tensor
assert xy.requires_grad — the docstring and provided template explicitly do this sanity check before optimizing

xy_list = [xy.detach().clone()] ... xy_list.append(xy.detach().clone()) — markdown explicitly warns 'shouldn't store past values like xy_list.append(xy) because then past elements ... will be modified'
fn(xy[0], xy[1]).backward() inside the loop produces gradients into xy.grad
return t.stack(xy_list) — collapse the per-step snapshots into a single (n_iters+1, 2) trajectory tensor
fn(...).backward(); optimizer.step(); optimizer.zero_grad() — the canonical fwd/loss/back/step/zero loop body, applied to a non-model tensor
